content:
#5 Book HoTT’s universe hierarchy does not use the natural numbers to define the universe levels, since there is no second-order induction principle in the theory at all (see section 1.3 and Appendix A.2).

Thus, there do exist non-standard versions of the hierarchy in Book HoTT (even uncountable versions) and it is incorrect to refer to Book HoTT’s hierarchy as “indexed by the natural numbers”.

Matthew Belmont
